name: Pummel / ally-hit-does-not-discard-hero-hand
notes: Explicitly attack Dromai Aether Ashwing, not the hero. Brutal Assault blue has printed base4 and is a valid cost2 Pummel target. The enhanced attack8 hits and destroys the 1-life ally; hero life stays20. The granted ability says hits a hero, so it must create no discard trigger/chooser and must preserve both hero hand cards. This differs from Razor, whose hit condition has no hero qualifier.
